articles.title_en: Electoral competition with costly policy changes: A dynamic perspective
articles.title_cn: 代价高昂的政策变更下的选举竞争：一个动态视角
articles.abstract_en: We analyze two-party electoral competition with a one-dimensional policy space, costly policy changes, and random negative shocks to a party's viability over an infinite horizon. We show the existence and uniqueness of stationary Markov perfect equilibria in which parties use so-called simple strategies. Regardless of the initial policy, party choices converge in the long run to a stochastic alternation between two policies, with transitions occurring if and only if parties suffer a negative shock to their viability. Although costs of change have a moderating effect on policies, full convergence to the median voter position does not take place when parties are polarized.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在一维政策空间、政策变更代价高昂以及政党生存能力受到随机负面冲击的无限期界下的两党选举竞争。我们证明了存在且唯一存在使用所谓简单策略的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡。无论初始政策如何，政党选择在长期内收敛于两种政策之间的随机交替，且仅当政党遭受生存能力负面冲击时才会发生转换。尽管变更成本对政策具有缓和作用，但当政党极化时，并不会完全收敛至中位选民位置。

articles.abstract_en: We examine the subjective value of gaining knowledge in a version of Savage's model for decisions under uncertainty in which the received outcome provides information about which event has obtained. Decision makers commonly value such knowledge either because they want to use it in future decisions or because they are personally interested in it. We find that in our model, the sure-thing principle and several other axioms of Savage are inconsistent with this value for knowledge about events. We provide a representation theorem for a subjective value of knowledge consisting of the sum of expected utility and a function of the information partition generated by the outcomes of an act. We characterize when the value of knowledge can be represented by a subjective value of knowledge about an information partition plus a Shannon entropy cost of processing information. Our results also provide a novel critique of the necessity of Savage's axioms for rational decisions under uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在萨维奇不确定性决策模型的一个版本中考察获取知识的主观价值，在该版本中，所获得的结果提供了关于哪个事件已经发生的信息。决策者通常重视此类知识，要么因为他们想在未来的决策中使用它，要么因为他们个人对此感兴趣。我们发现，在我们的模型中，确定事态原则和萨维奇的几个其他公理与这种对事件知识的价值不一致。我们提供了一个关于知识主观价值的表示定理，该价值由期望效用之和以及由行为结果生成的信息划分的函数组成。我们刻画了何时知识价值可以用关于信息划分的主观知识价值加上处理信息的香农熵成本来表示。我们的结果也为萨维奇公理在不确定性下理性决策中的必要性提供了新的批判。

articles.title_cn: 行为响应下的病毒动力学
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by epidemics such as COVID-19, we study the spread of a contagious disease when behavior responds to the disease's prevalence. We extend the SIR epidemiological model to include endogenous meeting rates. Individuals benefit from economic activity, but activity involves interactions with potentially infected individuals. The main focus is a theoretical analysis of contagion dynamics and behavioral responses to changes in risk. We obtain a simple condition for when public-health interventions or variants of a disease will have paradoxical effects on infection rates due to risk compensation. Behavioral responses are most likely to undermine public-health interventions near the peak of severe diseases.
articles.abstract_cn: 受COVID-19等流行病启发，我们研究了当行为对疾病流行程度作出响应时传染病的传播。我们将SIR流行病学模型扩展为包含内生相遇率。个体从经济活动中获益，但活动涉及与潜在感染者的互动。主要焦点是对传染动力学和风险变化行为响应的理论分析。我们得到了一个简单条件，在该条件下，公共卫生干预或疾病变种会因风险补偿而对感染率产生悖论性影响。行为响应最可能在严重疾病高峰期附近破坏公共卫生干预措施。

articles.title_en: On the voluntary disclosure of redundant information
articles.title_cn: 论冗余信息的自愿披露
articles.abstract_en: Why do firms engage in costly, voluntary disclosure of information which is subsumed by a later announcement? We consider a model in which the firm's manager can choose to disclose short-term information which becomes redundant later. When disclosure costs are sufficiently low, the manager discloses even if she only cares about the long-term price of the firm. Intuitively, by disclosing, she causes early investors to trade less aggressively, reducing price informativeness, which in turn increases information acquisition by late investors. The subsequent increase in acquisition more than offsets the initial decrease in price informativeness and, consequently, improves long term prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么企业会进行有成本的、自愿的信息披露，而这些信息后来会被后续公告所包含？我们考虑一个模型，其中企业经理可以选择披露后来变得冗余的短期信息。当披露成本足够低时，即使经理只关心企业的长期价格，她也会进行披露。直觉上，通过披露，她导致早期投资者交易不那么激进，降低了价格信息含量，这反过来又增加了后期投资者的信息获取。随后信息获取的增加超过了对价格信息含量初始减少的抵消，从而改善了长期价格。

articles.title_en: A fiscal theory of money and bank liquidity provision
articles.title_cn: 货币与银行流动性供给的财政理论
articles.abstract_en: Fiscal-backed money can provide additional liquidity to consumers and mitigate the liquidity shortage problem in an economy with banks where agents face idiosyncratic liquidity shocks without being fully insured. The government issues fiat money and creates real value for money by levying a tax and accepting money for tax payments. Tax reallocates the distribution of liquidity in the economy. An increase in tax, by increasing fiscal surplus and the real value of money, reduces the equilibrium investment. Additionally, imposing taxes influences the incentive of private information production, which may impose a constraint on optimal fiscal policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 财政支持的货币可以为消费者提供额外流动性，并在存在银行的经济中缓解流动性短缺问题，在该经济中，代理人面临特质性流动性冲击且未完全保险。政府发行法定货币，并通过征税和接受货币用于纳税来为货币创造实际价值。税收重新分配了经济中的流动性分布。税收增加，通过增加财政盈余和货币的实际价值，降低了均衡投资。此外，征税影响私人信息生产的激励，这可能对最优财政政策施加约束。

articles.title_en: Coherence without rationality at the zero lower bound
articles.title_cn: 零下限处的无理性一致性
articles.abstract_en: Standard rational expectations models with an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint either admit no solutions (incoherence) or multiple solutions (incompleteness). This paper shows that deviations from full-information rational expectations mitigate concerns about incoherence and incompleteness. Models with no rational expectations equilibria admit self-confirming equilibria involving the use of simple mis-specified forecasting models. Completeness and coherence are restored if expectations are adaptive or if agents are less forward-looking due to some information or behavioral friction. In the case of incompleteness, the E-stability criterion selects an equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有偶尔约束的零下限约束的标准理性预期模型要么没有解（不一致），要么有多个解（不完全）。本文表明，偏离完全信息理性预期的做法减轻了对不一致和不完全的担忧。没有理性预期均衡的模型允许存在涉及使用简单错误设定预测模型的自确认均衡。如果预期是适应性的，或者由于某些信息或行为摩擦而使代理人的前瞻性减弱，则完整性和一致性得以恢复。在不完全的情况下，E-稳定性准则选择一个均衡。

articles.title_cn: 秘密获取信息的信号传递
articles.abstract_en: We study the interplay between information acquisition and signaling. A sender decides whether to learn his type at a cost prior to taking a signaling action. A receiver observes the signaling action and responds. We characterize equilibria and apply a version of never a weak best response refinement in the environment where the information acquisition is observable as well as in the environment where it is covert. Covert information acquisition always leads to information acquisition when information is cheap. Observable information acquisition, on the other hand, does not necessarily.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息获取与信号传递之间的相互作用。发送者在采取信号行动之前，决定是否以一定成本了解自己的类型。接收者观察信号行动并作出回应。我们刻画了均衡，并在信息获取可观察以及秘密获取的环境中应用了从不弱最佳反应精炼的一个版本。当信息廉价时，秘密信息获取总是导致信息获取。另一方面，可观察的信息获取则不一定如此。

articles.abstract_en: We study the market for a risky asset in which traders are heterogeneous both in terms of their value for the asset and the information that they have about this value. Traders behave strategically and use the equilibrium price to extract information that is relevant to them. Due to adverse selection, uninformed traders are less willing than the informed to provide liquidity. We evaluate the impact of a change in the size or composition of the investor population on price informativeness, liquidity and welfare, with applications to the rise of passive investing and the adoption of ESG standards.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个风险资产市场，其中交易者在其资产价值以及他们关于该价值所拥有的信息方面都是异质的。交易者行为具有策略性，并利用均衡价格来提取与他们相关的信息。由于逆向选择，不知情交易者比知情交易者更不愿意提供流动性。我们评估投资者群体规模或构成的变化对价格信息含量、流动性和福利的影响，并将其应用于被动投资的兴起和ESG标准的采纳。

articles.abstract_en: We study how people form networks through introductions. We consider a model where players with different ability levels are connected in a network. The players seek to match with someone they are linked to in the network (i.e., their neighbors), and they prefer high-ability neighbors over low-ability ones. We investigate whether a player will strategically introduce two unacquainted neighbors to each other to improve her own matching outcome. We find that this is possible if (i) the player making the introduction is less capable than both of the neighbors she considers introducing, and (ii) there exists an even-length alternating path—a sequence of linked players that alternate between matching and not matching with the next player on the sequence—from one of the neighbors to the introducer. The characterization based on alternating paths arises because an introduction can trigger a chain of rematches along these paths. Then, we characterize stable networks and efficient networks, and we show that stability and efficiency do not imply each other. Finally, we consider several extensions, such as alternative matching processes and incomplete information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究人们如何通过介绍形成网络。我们考虑一个模型，其中具有不同能力水平的参与者在一个网络中相连。参与者寻求与网络中与之相连的人（即他们的邻居）匹配，并且他们偏好高能力的邻居而非低能力的邻居。我们研究一个参与者是否会策略性地将两个互不相识的邻居介绍给彼此，以改善自己的匹配结果。我们发现，如果（i）进行介绍的参与者比她要介绍的两个邻居的能力都低，并且（ii）存在一条偶数长度的交替路径——即一系列相连的参与者，他们依次与序列中的下一个参与者匹配或不匹配——从其中一个邻居到介绍者，那么这种介绍是可能的。基于交替路径的特征描述之所以出现，是因为一次介绍可以触发沿着这些路径的一系列重新匹配。然后，我们刻画了稳定网络和有效网络，并表明稳定性和有效性并不相互蕴含。最后，我们考虑了几个扩展，例如替代匹配过程和不完全信息。

articles.title_cn: 几乎完全信息下的讨价还价
articles.abstract_en: We consider the canonical frequent-offer Rubinstein bargaining game between two leaders on a policy issue. The public sentiment on this issue leans toward one leader or the other. Public sentiment determines the maximum compromise a leader can make without risking getting primaried. We introduce a positive probability ε that the leaders are uninformed about the sentiment. We show that a unique equilibrium emerges that resembles a war of attrition, in which one of the leaders may demand too much even after learning that the sentiment leans the other way. For a given bargaining environment, as ε converges to zero, in every state, the leaders almost immediately agree to the same policy position as they do under complete information. However, this convergence does not hold in the uniform sense, nor does it necessarily hold for more than two states.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在政策问题上两位领导人之间进行经典的高频出价鲁宾斯坦讨价还价博弈。公众情绪在此问题上倾向于其中一位领导人或另一位。公众情绪决定了领导人在不冒被初选击败风险的情况下所能做出的最大妥协。我们引入一个正概率ε，即领导人可能不了解公众情绪。我们证明存在一个独特的均衡，类似于消耗战，其中一位领导人即使在得知情绪倾向于另一方后，也可能要求过多。对于给定的讨价还价环境，当ε趋近于零时，在每种状态下，领导人几乎立即同意与完全信息下相同的政策立场。然而，这种收敛并非一致收敛，也不一定适用于多于两种状态的情况。

articles.title_en: A model of the gold standard
articles.abstract_en: We present a micro-founded monetary model of a small open economy to examine the behavior of money, prices, and output under the gold standard. In particular, we formally analyze Hume's celebrated price-specie flow mechanism. Our framework incorporates the influence of international trade on the money supply in the Home country through gold flows. In the short run, a positive correlation exists between the quantity of money and the price level. Additionally, we demonstrate that money is non-neutral during the transition to the steady state, which has implications for welfare. While the gold standard exposes the Home country to short-term fluctuations in money, prices, and output caused by external shocks, it ensures long-term price stability as the quantity of money and prices only temporarily deviate from their steady-state levels. We discuss the importance of policy coordination for achieving efficiency under the gold standard and consider the role of fiat money in this environment. We also develop a version of the model with two large economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个小型开放经济的微观基础货币模型，以考察金本位下货币、价格和产出的行为。特别是，我们正式分析了休谟著名的价格-铸币流动机制。我们的框架通过黄金流动将国际贸易对本国货币供应的影响纳入其中。在短期内，货币数量与价格水平之间存在正相关关系。此外，我们证明了在向稳态过渡期间货币是非中性的，这对福利具有影响。虽然金本位使本国面临由外部冲击引起的货币、价格和产出的短期波动，但它确保了长期价格稳定，因为货币数量和价格只是暂时偏离其稳态水平。我们讨论了在金本位下实现效率的政策协调的重要性，并考虑了法定货币在这种环境中的作用。我们还开发了一个包含两个大型经济体的模型版本。

articles.abstract_en: Economic agents are motivated to undertake costly actions by the prospect of being rewarded for successes and punished for failures. But what determines what a success looks like? This paper endogenizes the criteria for success in an otherwise standard principal-agent model with risk neutrality and limited liability. The set of feasible contracts is constrained by incentive constraints and possibly by a budget constraint. The first-order approach is not required to solve the problem. If the principal manipulates the criteria for success only to lower implementation costs, and depending on which type of constraint is more restrictive, the second-best action may be above or below the first-best action. In a class of problems where the principal's payoff depends directly on the criteria for success, the second-best solution features either more stringent criteria for success or a lower action (or both) than the first-best solution.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济主体因预期成功会得到奖励、失败会受到惩罚而采取有成本的行为。但什么决定了成功的样子？本文在一个具有风险中性和有限责任的标准委托-代理模型中，将成功标准内生化。可行契约集受到激励约束以及可能的预算约束的限制。求解该问题不需要一阶方法。如果委托人仅为了降低实施成本而操纵成功标准，并且取决于哪种类型的约束更具限制性，次优行动可能高于或低于最优行动。在一类委托人的收益直接取决于成功标准的问题中，次优解的特征是比最优解更严格的成功标准或更低的行动（或两者兼有）。

articles.title_en: The ratchet effect: A learning perspective
articles.title_cn: 棘轮效应：一个学习视角
articles.abstract_en: We examine the ratchet effect under moral hazard and symmetric learning by worker and firm about new technology. Shirking increases the worker's future payoffs, since the firm overestimates job difficulty. High-powered incentives to deter shirking induce the agent to over-work, since he can quit if the firm thinks the job is too easy. With continuous effort choices, no deterministic interior effort is implementable. We provide conditions under which randomized effort is implementable, so that a profit-maximizing distribution over efforts exists.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在道德风险和工人与企业对新技术的对称学习下的棘轮效应。偷懒会增加工人未来的收益，因为企业会高估工作难度。为防止偷懒而设的高强度激励会诱使代理人过度工作，因为如果企业认为工作太容易，他可以辞职。在连续努力选择下，任何确定性的内部努力都是不可实施的。我们提供了随机努力可实施的条件，从而存在一个利润最大化的努力分布。

articles.abstract_en: I study a Bayesian persuasion model in which multiple senders sequentially persuade one receiver, after observing signal structures of prior senders and their realizations. I develop a geometric method, recursive concavification, to characterize the Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium paths. I prove the existence of the silent equilibrium, where at most one sender provides nontrivial information. I also show that when there are only two senders and the receiver has a finite action space, it is generically without loss to focus on silent equilibrium. Finally, I show that if there are two senders who have zero-sum payoffs, the truth-telling signal structure is always supported in equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个贝叶斯说服模型，其中多个发送者在观察到先前发送者的信号结构及其实现后，序贯地说服一个接收者。我开发了一种几何方法，即递归凹化，来刻画完美贝叶斯均衡路径。我证明了沉默均衡的存在性，其中至多一个发送者提供非平凡信息。我还表明，当只有两个发送者且接收者具有有限行动空间时，通常不失一般性地可以关注沉默均衡。最后，我表明如果存在两个具有零和收益的发送者，那么说真话的信号结构总是在均衡中得到支持。
